verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile documents opening new pull requests from the phone, but only through Copilot: asking Copilot in natural language, or assigning an issue to Copilot to get a ready-to-review PR. There is no evidence of manually creating a PR from your own branch, and a community user describes the app as not really a git client, so the capability rests on an AI-mediated path only. missing for 10: documented manual PR creation (choosing base/compare branches, title and description), support for hosted Git platforms beyond GitHub, hands-on corroboration of mobile PR creation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create pull requests on hosted Git platforms directly from my device

citations.quote: open a new pull request – all in natural language
Assign issues to Copilot and get a ready-to-review pull request. Use comments to refine, iterate, approve and merge—all directly within GitHub Mobile.
